avis.titre: The Cosmic Fix for Your Peepers!
avis.texte: If your eyes are screaming for help due to the relentless aging process or just the general entropy of the universe, then CeraVe Eye Repair Cream might just be the intergalactic aid you need. This little tube of wonders has turned my under-eye area from looking like it's been through a black hole to something more akin to a rejuvenated nebula. It's like they took the essence of hydration and anti-aging properties, mixed it with a bit of stardust, and voilà! - **Hydration**: It's like watering the parched deserts of Mars, but for your eyes. My skin drank it up faster than tourists at a spaceport bar. - **Dark Circles**: They promised to tackle those pesky shadows under my eyes, and while they didn't quite banish them to another dimension, they've definitely faded them into the background. - **Puffiness**: If your eyes puff up like a balloon in zero gravity, this cream is your decompressor. - **Ease of Use**: Lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs faster than information traveling through a neural network. Plus, it's fragrance-free, so no alien scents to offend your olfactory sensors. - **Cost**: At a price that won't require you to rob a bank, it's like getting a luxury spaceship for the price of a shuttle ride. In conclusion, if you're looking for an eye cream that won't make your wallet cry but will make your eyes smile, CeraVe Eye Repair Cream is your ticket. It's not a miracle worker, but for daily maintenance in the harsh environment of Earth, it's pretty stellar.

I think the CeraVe Eye Repair Cream is pretty good. I used it for a little while and it made the skin under my eyes feel really soft. It wasn't greasy and it soaked into my skin fast. I don't think it made my dark circles disappear, but it did help my eyes look less puffy in the morning. It also didn't make my skin itchy or burn, which I liked because my skin is kind of sensitive. I think it's a good product if you want your under eyes to feel moisturized, but don't expect a huge change overnight.

avis.titre: Takes time but it’s worth it
avis.texte: I’ve been using this eye repair cream for about six weeks now, and I’m really happy with the results. The skin around my eyes feels smoother and more hydrated, and I’ve noticed a visible reduction in puffiness and fine lines. It has a light texture that absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue, which I really appreciate. The only reason I didn’t give it five stars is that it took a few weeks before I started seeing noticeable changes — it’s definitely more of a gradual improvement than an overnight fix. That said, the results are worth the wait. My under-eyes look brighter and more refreshed, and I’ll definitely keep this as part of my skincare routine.

To be honest - I can't really tell if this does anything for my eye bags. (I don't have any puffiness or other symptoms, just kind of dark circles under my eyes) but I think my "eye bags" are just genetic from being part Korean (I'm mostly white/British). It's more like just darker circles under my eyes not really bags so maybe I'm just not the right customer for this. But it seems inexpensive, and you only have to use the tiniest little amount at a time under your eyes so it will last a long time - I do feel a slight tingle when I use them and an 'awareness' of the sensation of something cool below my eyes but I genuinely have not noticed a difference in my dark eye circles. (Like I said - I don't have them from like a lack of sleep or lack of care for myself, I think it's just my genes so maybe I'm not the right customer for this). So with all that said, I'm giving 5 stars anyway because I'm sure it's not hurting me and it feels like a quality product even if I'm not seeing the results I was hoping for.

avis.titre: Honest Review After 3 Months of Use!
avis.texte: I’ve been using this eye cream every night for over three months. The texture is light and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling moisturized, especially during dry winter months. It layers well under makeup without feeling greasy. However, I haven’t noticed any clear improvement in fine lines, dark circles, or puffiness. It’s gentle and doesn’t cause irritation, which is a plus. For basic hydration, it works fine, but if you expect visible anti-aging effects, this may not meet your expectations. Overall, it’s a decent, affordable option for light moisture, but I hope it shows more results with longer use. I will keep using it to see if it improves over time.

After a few days of regular usage, there is a marked difference in brightness and firmness, and no irritation. The texture is light and not greasy at all. In my book, this product is well worth the money. A small amount goes a long way.

As for puffiness, it’s a little better but nothing to write about.. No difference in wrinkles—but again, I don’t use it every day. Maybe if I did I’d see less puffiness and wrinkles. And one other thing—I did not experience any burning or eye inflammation from using this cream. While I still occasionally get bouts of the weepiness—not related to use of this cream—my eyes have never again taken on that “bruised” look.

avis.titre: Cause damage to my skin. Expired
avis.texte: I am extremely disappointed with this purchase. I ordered this on January 16, 2026. The box arrived smashed, open, and completely unsealed. For an eye product, that is already concerning. Unfortunately, I still decided to try it. I used it as directed for about three days. One morning I woke up with severely swollen upper and lower eyelids. Shortly after, the skin around my eyes became extremely dry, wrinkled, and painfully irritated. It burns even when it comes into contact with water, and several days later it still has not improved. After this reaction, I checked the lot code and discovered it was manufactured October 1, 2022 and expired October 1, 2025. That means it was already expired when I received it in January 2026. Receiving an expired, unsealed product that caused such a strong reaction is unacceptable — especially for something meant to be used around the eyes. I would strongly recommend checking the expiration date and ensuring the product is sealed before using.

Short Version: This caused an allergic reaction for me causing dark circles to be worse, wrinkles pronounced, redness, burning, and eye irritation. Nothing super severe, but the redness lasted for about 3-5 days. The photos were taken days after using the product. I think this is uncommon but please use caution. Long version: Let me start this off by saying I love CeraVa products. I use their face wash every day. Knowing that, you can understand I don’t have some kind of vendetta against them. I used this product a number of times each causing an allergic reaction. I just thought that was the product reacting with a type of lotion, sunscreen, ect… something else I may have had on my skin. The final time using this I used it by itself and it still caused this redness and irritation. Finally I was convinced it was the eye cream by itself. With that being said I am incredibly disappointed because now I’m nervous to try any eye creams going forward. Let me also say that I think most people will be fine, but apparently I have sensitive skin/am allergic to something in this. If you notice burning, redness, or any of the other symptoms similar, DO NOT assume that it’s something else. Stop using it and don’t do what I did. Thanks for reading and I hope this helps you make a more informed decision.

If you know you have lotion on, it means you can feel it lingering in some way. This CeraVe makes my eyes feel relaxed and look like I slept well, amazingly, by plumping up my skin somewhat (in a good way), since I usually have very dry skin. A few minutes after applying this, and I can't feel any trace of lotion- just good skin. There's also no scent, which is great. The tube is very small, but the amount I have squeezed out in my pic is the amount I use for both my eyes for one application. At this rate, this small tube could last months using it on a daily basis. I love CeraVe products, and have used their facial cleanser for years. I'm just starting to try their creams, and am finding them superior, just like their cleanser.

avis.texte: This was the worst eye cream ever. My eyes got super red, swollen and itchy. I looked like a totally different person. I think I might have been allergic to some ingrediant in this cream. Be very cautios when using this if you have sensitive skin. I recommend using something natural like coconut oil if you want moisturization. I am using that now and wow it moisturizes a million times better than this cream. I would not recommend this cream for people with sensitive skin. My swollen eyes took about 4 days to finally go away. It was the worst!!

I bought this stuff at Target, but wanted to share my review somewhere that it will be seen more. I inherited fair skin from my German mother and very dark circles from my Lebanese/Mexican father. These dark circles just JUMP out at you on my face and I've had them my whole life regardless of what I eat, how much I sleep etc. I never could leave the house without concealer and no creams ever worked for me in the past. I decided I should try this one because, I guess why not? I had heard great things about the product, so I decided to document my efforts. :-) I used it twice a day every day after washing my face. I put little dots around the bottom and top of my eyes (because I felt my eyelids were also rather dark) and gently massaged it into the skin. I can let you be the judge, but to me, this is so much more of an improvement than I've ever seen before! If you're like me and have naturally dark circles under the eyes, unfortunately you can't expect a miracle from any cream. I still will wear concealer when going out, but I don't feel so ashamed of my dark circles anymore. :-) Here you can see a bit of a before and after. Top picture was taken Jan. 25 bottom was taken today, April. 12. Bonus fact: I have very sensitive skin and this was very soothing and not irritating in the least.
